prompt: In the original RAG paper (Lewis et al.), what plays the role of non-parametric memory?

options.text: The weights of the pre-trained seq2seq generator.
A dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever.

explanation: RAG combines parametric memory (a pre-trained seq2seq model) with non-parametric memory, which in the paper is a dense vector index of Wikipedia accessed by a neural retriever. Retrieval gives access to updatable knowledge and provenance.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks (Lewis et al.)
